node-1.label: A woman in her 40s presented with a 3-year history of a complex progressive disorder characterized by emotional lability, cognitive decline, generalized ataxia, and autonomic dysfunction

node-2.label: Autonomic testing revealed abnormal cardiac parasympathetic function without orthostatic hypotension, patchy decrease in sweat output on quantitative sudomotor axon reflex test, and markedly abnormal thermoregulatory sweat test with near complete global anhidrosis

node-3.label: Patient denied paresthesias, dysesthesias, or loss of sensation
